content: AUTOSAR Shall Provide Guidance for Identification of Not Yet Described Aspects within Profiles for Data Exchange Points 46 of 57  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 536: AUTOSAR_RS_StandardizationTemplate Requirements on Standardization Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 Type: valid Description: The standardization template shall specify guidelines that help to identify not yet described aspects of a data exchange point. Rationale: The profile allows for referencing spec items, constraints, meta classes, etc. that are mentioned in AUTOSAR specifications. The guidelines e.g. provides guidance on how to leverage existing information in AUTOSAR specifications in order to find related information (e.g. via upstream mapping, cross references, technical terms, ...)
